name: 97401 · Eugene, OR
findings: ZIP 97401 (Eugene) has 349 nonprofit organizations. 160 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 136 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97401 (Eugene) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97401 (Eugene) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
